embeds.title: WELCOME TO THE DYNASTY BASEBALL LEAGUE
embeds.description:
**DBL** is a 12-franchise dynasty fantasy baseball league built around long-term roster construction, prospect development, an active trade market, daily competition, and permanent league history.

**Fantrax runs the game. Discord runs the league.**

fields.name: START HERE
fields.value:
**📜│constitution** — League rules and amendments.
**📢│announcements** — Official league notices.
**📅│league-calendar** — Important dates and deadlines.
**💰│league-ledger** — Dues and league accounting.

fields.name: THE DBL STANDARD
fields.value: Build for the long term. Stay active. Make your own moves. Own your decisions. Compete every week.

embeds.title: HOW THE DBL WORKS
embeds.description: The league uses two homes with different jobs. Keeping those jobs separate makes disputes, records, and league administration much cleaner.

fields.name: FANTRAX — THE GAME RECORD
fields.value:
Rosters • Lineups • Scoring • Adds/Drops • FAAB • Trades • Standings • Playoff Results

If a gameplay transaction or result exists in Fantrax, Fantrax is the authoritative record.

fields.name: DISCORD — THE CLUBHOUSE
fields.value: Announcements • Voting • Trade Market • Scouting • League Discussion • Records • Draft-Day Communication • Commissioner Support

fields.name: ONE FRANCHISE, ONE VOICE
fields.value: Co-owners may help manage a franchise, but each franchise has **one formal league vote** and **one dues obligation**.

embeds.title: SERVER MAP
embeds.description: Every category has a job. Use the right room and the server stays useful instead of becoming one giant chat.

fields.name: 🏛️ LEAGUE OFFICE
fields.value: Governance, constitution, announcements, calendar, ledger, voting, the hall of champions and league records.

fields.name: 📰 THE WIRE
fields.value: Breaking MLB news, injuries, transactions, prospects and league-wide news discussion.

fields.name: 💼 GENERAL MANAGERS
fields.value: The clubhouse: GM Lounge, game-day talk, chirps, memes, off-topic conversation and media.

fields.name: 🔄 TRADE CENTER
fields.value: Trade blocks, acquisition targets, trade discussion, completed trades and dynasty player values.

fields.name: 🌱 SCOUTING DEPARTMENT
fields.value: One prospect forum covering the minors, college, international signings, the MLB Draft and the DBL draft, sorted by tags.

fields.name: 💰 WAIVER WIRE
fields.value: FAAB strategy, recently dropped players and players worth watching. Actual claims remain in Fantrax.

fields.name: 🏆 LEAGUE COMPETITION
fields.value: Weekly scoreboards, standings, recaps, playoffs and the consolation bracket.

fields.name: ⚖️ COMMISSIONER'S OFFICE
fields.value: Private tickets, public rules questions and league suggestions.

fields.name: 🎯 DRAFT CENTER
fields.value: Startup and annual draft announcements, round results, draft-day trades and live discussion. Fantrax sends the on-the-clock alerts.

fields.name: ⚾ FRANCHISE HQ
fields.value: The franchise directory, franchise news and roster showcases.

embeds.title: FRANCHISE OWNERSHIP & ROLES
embeds.description: Discord roles reflect league function. They are not extra votes or extra franchises.

fields.name: ⚾ FRANCHISE OWNER
fields.value: Primary owner role. Full league participation and the franchise's formal league vote.

fields.name: 🤝🏻 CO-OWNER
fields.value: Full team-management and community access. Co-owners do **not** create a second league vote.

fields.name: ⚜️ FOUNDING OWNER
fields.value: Permanent recognition for original DBL ownership.

fields.name: 🏆 / 🥇 HONOR ROLES
fields.value: League Champion and Presidents' Trophy roles recognize current title holders.

fields.name: 🗳️ FORMAL VOTING
fields.value: Only the Franchise Owner role posts the franchise's vote in **🗳️│league-voting**. Co-owners can view the channel but remain read-only by design.

embeds.title: KEEP OFFICIAL BUSINESS OFFICIAL
embeds.description: The DBL should feel like a baseball league, not paperwork. The easiest way to keep it that way is to put official actions in the places designed for them.

fields.name: TRADES
fields.value: Use Discord to shop, negotiate and discuss. **Finalize trades in Fantrax.** Fantrax remains the authoritative transaction record.

fields.name: WAIVERS / FAAB
fields.value: Discuss targets in Discord. **Submit actual claims and bids in Fantrax.**

fields.name: RULES QUESTIONS
fields.value: Use **❓│rules-questions** when an interpretation should be visible to the whole league.

fields.name: PRIVATE ISSUES
fields.value: Use **🎟️│open-a-ticket** for private Commissioner matters instead of burying an issue in DMs.

fields.name: LEAGUE CHANGES
fields.value: Official announcements, votes and amendments belong in the League Office so the record is permanent.

embeds.title: YOU'RE CLEARED FOR THE ROOM
embeds.description:
Before jumping in, confirm your **Franchise Owner** or **Co-Owner** role and make sure you can see the league categories you need.

Then review the constitution, check the league calendar, and head to **💬│gm-lounge**.

**Welcome to the DBL. Grab a hot dog. Set your lineup. Make bad trades confidently.**
